mapper.sql: id, name, type, connection_params, user_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
select e.id, e.name, e.type, e.user_id, e.connection_params, e.create_time, e.update_time, u.user_name as user_name from t_ds_external_system e join t_ds_user u on e.user_id = u.id where 1 = 1
and e.id in ( select external_system_id from t_ds_relation_external_system_user where user_id=#{userId} union select id as external_system_id from t_ds_external_system where user_id=#{userId} )
and e.name like concat ('%', #{name}, '%')
order by e.update_time desc
